definitions.explanation: The planet on which we live; the third planet from the sun in our solar system.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}の{環境|かんきょう}を{守|まも}ることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It is important to protect the Earth's environment.

examples.japanese: {地球|ちきゅう}は{太陽|たいよう}の{周|まわ}りを{一年|いちねん}で{回|まわ}る。
examples.english: The Earth revolves around the sun in one year.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{地球|ちきゅう}を{守|まも}る (protect the Earth)
・{地球|ちきゅう}に{優|やさ}しい (environmentally friendly, lit. 'kind to the Earth')
・{地球|ちきゅう}の{環境|かんきょう} (Earth's environment)

COMMON COMPOUND WORDS:
・{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか} (global warming)
・{地球|ちきゅう}{儀|ぎ} (globe, model of Earth)
・{地球|ちきゅう}{環境|かんきょう} (global environment)
